result.instructions: Tools for Hostfully, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hostfully data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run hostfully_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hostfully_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hostfully_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. hostfully_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hostfully_list_agencies
tools.title: List agencies
tools.description: List the agencies this API key can access, with their UIDs, currency and default check-in/out times. Start here to find the agency_uid other tools need. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/agencies.

tools.name: hostfully_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List an agency's properties (rentals) with name, address, type, bedrooms, active flag and pricing/availability settings. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/properties.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this UTC time, e.g. 2026-04-20T11:52:36.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: hostfully_get_property
tools.title: Get one property
tools.description: Fetch one property's full details — address, time zone, rooms, pricing and availability settings, channel data, booking notes and cancellation policy. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/properties/{propertyUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_get_property_calendar
tools.title: Get a property's calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability and pricing for one property over a date range — the direct answer to 'is it free, and at what price?'. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/property-calendar/{propertyUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_get_pricing_periods
tools.title: Get pricing periods
tools.description: The nightly price, minimum stay and check-in/check-out availability set for each date of one property over a range. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/pricing-periods.

tools.name: hostfully_search_leads
tools.title: Search leads and bookings
tools.description: Search leads — Hostfully's word for bookings, inquiries, booking requests and calendar blocks — by agency, property or UIDs, and by check-in/check-out date. Returns status, type, channel, dates and guest info. Give at least one of agency_uid (or the default), property_uid, or lead_uids. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/leads.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this UTC time, e.g. 2026-04-20T11:52:36.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: hostfully_get_lead
tools.title: Get one lead or booking
tools.description: Fetch one lead (booking, inquiry, booking request or block) by UID — status, channel, dates, guest information, notes and assignee. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/leads/{leadUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_calculate_quote
tools.title: Calculate a stay quote
tools.description: Price a prospective stay at one property: rent, fees, taxes, security deposit and total for the given dates and party. Computes only — creates nothing. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/quotes.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

lead_uid.description: Quote in the context of an existing lead.

tools.name: hostfully_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders — the money side of a booking: rent, fees, services, adjustments, taxes, channel commission and total. Filter by lead, property, guest or update time (at least one is required). Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/orders.

lead_uid.description: Only the order of this lead.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this UTC time, e.g. 2026-04-20T11:52:36.

tools.name: hostfully_list_threads
tools.title: List message threads
tools.description: List guest-messaging threads for an agency or one lead, with participants and read status. Give lead_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/threads.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: hostfully_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: Read guest messages (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app) for a lead, a thread or a whole agency, with sender type, status and content. Give lead_uid, thread_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/messages.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: hostfully_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List the agency's guest records — names, email, phone, address and profile notes. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/guests/{agencyUid}.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

tools.name: hostfully_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List operational jobs (cleanings, greetings, maintenance and other services) scheduled in a date window, optionally for given properties and statuses, sorted by start date. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/jobs.

modified_since.description: Only jobs modified on or after this date; Hostfully requires it, default 2000-01-01 (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: hostfully_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services an agency offers or schedules (cleaning, transportation, greeting, cooking, tours ...), with provider, price and duration. A service UID is what hostfully_create_job needs. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/services.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

tools.name: hostfully_list_reviews
tools.title: List guest reviews
tools.description: List guest reviews for a property or a lead — rating, title, content, source, private feedback and the host response. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/reviews.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this UTC time, e.g. 2026-04-20T11:52:36.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: hostfully_list_owners
tools.title: List property owners
tools.description: List the agency's property owners — contact details, business name, commission rate and permissions — optionally filtered by a search string. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/owners.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

tools.name: hostfully_create_lead
tools.title: Create a calendar block or inquiry
tools.description: Create a lead at one property: status BLOCKED puts an owner/maintenance block on the calendar; status NEW records a guest inquiry (which does not confirm a booking or take payment). Blocks can later be removed in Hostfully; inquiries go through the normal pipeline. Dates are local to the property. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/leads.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

guest.description: Guest information — needed for an inquiry, usually omitted for a block.

email.description: Guest email (Hostfully requires it when guest info is given).

external_booking_id.description: Your own reference for this lead.

annotations.title: Create a calendar block or inquiry

tools.name: hostfully_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead's notes or guest details
tools.description: Partially update a lead's notes, extra notes and guest details (name, contact, address, arrival/departure times). Does NOT change dates, party size, property or status. Hostfully may ignore personal-data fields the key is not allowed to edit. Hostfully: PATCH /api/v3.3/leads/{leadUid}.

guest.description: Guest fields to change; omitted fields are kept.

annotations.title: Update a lead's notes or guest details

tools.name: hostfully_send_message
tools.title: Send a message to a guest
tools.description: Send a message to the guest of a lead, by EMAIL or as a DIRECT_MESSAGE on the booking channel (Airbnb, VRBO or Booking.com leads only). This reaches a real guest and cannot be unsent — confirm the text first. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/messages.

lead_uid.description: The lead whose guest receives the message.

type.description: EMAIL, or DIRECT_MESSAGE via the channel.

annotations.title: Send a message to a guest

tools.name: hostfully_create_job
tools.title: Schedule a job
tools.description: Schedule a job (e.g. a cleaning or a guest greeting) for a service at a property, optionally tied to a lead. Times are property-local. hostfully_list_services gives the service UID. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/jobs.
